headline: Indian markets face global tech rout after record domestic gains; Nifty holds 24,500 level

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Global equity rout in US and Asia triggered by AI sector concerns and tech washout
Indian indices logged their biggest single-day gains in seven months on November 5
Sharp declines in Nikkei and South Korean markets saps global risk appetite
Falling crude oil prices and foreign flows provide a domestic cushion against global cues
whatHappening: Sensex surged over 2,000 points and Nifty topped 24,500 in the previous session
Wall Street's Nasdaq and S&P 500 sank 4% due to an AI-led market washout
Eight large-cap Indian stocks have crossed above their 200-day moving averages
Financial and auto sectors led the recent domestic rally while IT indices faced pressure
summary: Indian markets are opening amid a global selloff triggered by a tech washout in the US and major slumps in Asian indices like the Nikkei. While domestic sentiment was bolstered by record gains and falling oil prices on Thursday, international headwinds are now dominating the outlook. Investors are closely watching US payrolls data and regional geopolitical developments for further direction.
